collection: WASTI NEXUS Extended Model & Capability Registry
policy: Discovery records only. The twelve pinned GGUF entries in nexus-model-catalog.json are the only archive-ready models. Every entry here requires an exact checkpoint, immutable revision, checksum, licence review, runtime adapter and device/server validation before activation.
storage: Google Drive via Android SAF for private model and training artefact archives. No Cloudflare R2 or other Cloudflare object storage.

activation_requirements: pin exact upstream checkpoint and immutable revision
capture complete licence and usage-policy text
verify architecture, tokenizer and quantization support
calculate memory and storage requirements
run automated smoke and evaluation tests
record device or server benchmark
